name: Mahou Senshi Symphonic Knights ~Megami o Tsugu Otome-tachi~
original_name: 魔法戦士シンフォニックナイツ～女神を継ぐ乙女たち～
source:
"The repeated invasion from the other world has started to change this world's structure. The "Magic Power" which did not originally exist has emerged and became the new axis of the world. Upon the birth of the new powers, came the evildoers and the creatures from the other world who are attracted to the power.

Meanwhile, there are young girls who use the their own magic power to transform themselves into magnificent warriors. They stand in the battlefield as allies of justice to protect people from the danger and monsters. Those girl are called 『Mahou Senshi』(Magical Warrior).

On the other side, there exist those who would get their hand on the "Magic Power" to experiment, understand, or use it to conquer the world. One of those men is Amatsuka, who is a talented and ambitious man as well as one of the researchers of 『Imperio』, the company that quickly realized the potential of magic power. One day, when Ametsuka was frustrating about his position, he met a man named 『Metzer Heinkel』 who became can make his ambition into reality.

Thus, Amatsuka begins his fight to realize his dream of dominating the world using magic. However, standing in his way are the lovely warriors of the combined power of magic and science in the beautiful outfit『Symphonic Knights』. Amatsuka begins to strategize against the innocent girls to corrupt them with his new powers and monster minions."

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=360745]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
「異世界接二連三的入侵，開始改變這個世界的構造。原本並不存在的『魔力』隨之湧現，成為維繫新時代的中軸。新力量誕生後，惡徒以及受到魔力吸引的異界生物也相繼現身。

與此同時，一群少女能夠運用自身魔力，變身為英姿颯爽的戰士。為了保護人們免遭危險與魔物侵害，她們以正義使者的身分踏上戰場。這些少女被稱作『魔法戰士』。

另一邊，也有人企圖將『魔力』據為己有，或用來實驗、研究，或藉此征服世界。雨塚鷹佑便是其中之一。他才華出眾、野心勃勃，是最早察覺魔力潛力的企業『Imperio』旗下研究員。一天，正因自身處境而焦躁不已的雨塚遇見了名叫『梅策爾．海因克爾』的男人，對方擁有令其野心化為現實的力量。

於是，雨塚為了實現以魔法支配世界的夢想，開始了自己的戰鬥。然而，擋在他面前的是一群身披美麗戰衣、融合魔法與科學力量的可愛戰士——『交響騎士』。面對這些天真無邪的少女，雨塚開始策劃如何運用新得到的力量與麾下魔物，令她們一步步墮落。」

[譯自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=360745]Getchu[/url]]
